title: Show HN: Bigwords.page – Turn any screen into a sign. The URL is the app
summary: Bigwords.page is a web app that turns any screen into a large-text sign by encoding the message directly in the URL, so no installation or account is needed. It is a lightweight utility rather than an AI/ML system, though it may have been built with AI assistance. The Show HN post drew 600 points and 145 comments.
